partner_result.applied_to: comparison p_shared-heavy(0) <= 3 sqrt(2) = partner diffuse extremal central peak

new_result.statement: If J=diag(1,1,-1), ||v||<1, X has density <=1, and G is independent N(0,sigma^2(I-vv^T)) with sigma^2>=1/12, then for Q=(vX+G)^T J(vX+G), p_Q(0)<=3sqrt(2); at sigma^2=1/12 the inequality is strict for v!=0.

unpaid_implication: No bound yet for sup_t p_Q(t) in the one-heavy model and no finite-row local-limit transfer. Remaining witness mechanisms include at least two interacting macroscopic rows, anisotropic/non-Gaussian residual structure, off-center peaks, or finite-row spikes invisible under weak convergence.
next_step: Analyze two interacting heavy rows or derive a uniform-in-t version of the cone-line/bathtub argument before returning to additional diffuse asymptotics.
